subject.title: Webchat messages with both typed text + inline image attachment are misclassified as source_modality: image

question: Should OpenClaw define a new public `source_modality` value for mixed text-and-image WebChat input, or keep that internal runtime-context metadata out of the user/agent contract?
rationale: The current report asks for a new taxonomy and workspace exposure model in addition to a possible delivery bug; source inspection alone cannot choose the durable public contract.

options.title: Validate the existing contract first
options.body: Reproduce the exact payload and repair only caption or media-reference loss while retaining managed `media://inbound/*` storage.

options.title: Adopt a multimodal contract
options.body: Specify and document a stable mixed-input modality field plus compatibility behavior before implementation.

options.title: Reject workspace mirroring
options.body: Keep files in managed media storage and expose only the existing resolved reference/tool path where supported.

recommendation.title: Validate the existing contract first
recommendation.body: Reproduce the exact payload and repair only caption or media-reference loss while retaining managed `media://inbound/*` storage.

likelyOwner.reason: A current core Gateway/media owner is needed to choose whether this becomes a public message-context contract.
